description: This is the entry point for a React-based frontend application. It imports React and ReactDOM, applies global styles from index.css, and renders the root React component App inside a StrictMode wrapper into the DOM element with id 'root'.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components within a specific DOM node.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders a React element into the created root.
